clue.text: Scattered debris cut by a diver, say

indicators.note: the rearranged word is split open by the following letter, as if cut
scattered things are thrown about, so the letters of debris are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Flotsam strewn about is sliced through by someone plunging into the water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scattered' turns DEBRIS into SEBIRD, and 'cut by' puts A inside it. A diver is one example of a bird of the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Divers, also called loons, are water birds that hunt fish by plunging under the sea, so one is an example.

clue.text: Priest counterfeited article

parts.note: counterfeited means faked, sham
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A clergyman has forged a piece of writing.
explanation.definitionFit: A tribal holy man who deals with the spirit world serves as the community's priest.

clue.text: In midst of dread, bringing doctor in

indicators.note: the closing word says the doctor goes inside the word for dread

parts.note: angst is dread or anxiety
MO is a medical officer, a doctor

explanation.surface: Amid fear, someone summons the physician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' at the start is part of the definition; 'bringing' is only a link, and the final 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases mean surrounded by or among others.

clue.text: Top colleges? Girl's a long way to go

parts.note: Ivy is a girl's name; the 's is a link
a league is an old measure of distance, about three miles

explanation.surface: A young woman faces a lengthy journey ahead, perhaps to university.
explanation.definitionFit: The group of elite old universities in the north-eastern US, such as Harvard and Yale, are the most prestigious colleges.

clue.text: Act as substitute partner for man? Nonsense!

parts.note: to double for someone is to stand in for them
'my old Dutch' is Cockney slang for a man's wife

explanation.surface: Someone is asked to stand in as a man's partner and objects that it is rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: DUTCH for wife comes from Cockney London slang, 'Duchess of Fife' rhyming with wife.
explanation.definitionFit: Speech that cannot be understood is gibberish, mere nonsense.

clue.text: Take responsibility for a small charge

definitions.text: Take responsibility for a small charge

parts.words: Take responsibility for a small charge
parts.note: reads like accepting blame for a minor offence or fee, but the small charge is a child left in one's care

explanation.definitionFit: Minding a youngster while the parents are out means looking after a little person entrusted to you.

clue.text: Save from upturned boat

indicators.note: in a down clue, upturned means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a tub is a slow, clumsy boat

explanation.surface: Rescue someone from a capsized vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Save in the sense of except, as in 'all save one'.

clue.text: Petty officer's short spell

parts.note: reads like a brief stint served by a naval officer, but means the shortened way of writing that officer's title

explanation.definitionFit: This is the contracted spelling of boatswain, the ship's officer in charge of rigging and deck crew.

clue.text: Warriors in USA I arm after disaster

indicators.note: after a disaster things are in disarray, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Fighters in America arm themselves after a catastrophe.
explanation.definitionFit: The hereditary military class of feudal Japan were sword-carrying fighters.

clue.text: Preparing for sport, as alternative to Can't wait Single clues 09068 446 001. All A being coached

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held is garbled by newspaper text: 'Preparing for sport, as alternative to Can't wait Single clues 09068 446 001. All A being coached (8)'; an advert runs through it and no scan shows the printed clue.
annotationWithheld.clue: Preparing for sport, as alternative to Can't wait Single clues 09068 446 001. All A being coached

clue.text: Columnist, relatively sympathetic?

definitions.meaning: a newspaper writer who answers readers' personal problems
a family member, a relative, who feels for your pain

explanation.definitionFit: The writer of a problem page is pictured as a kindly female relative sympathising with sufferers.

clue.text: A bird no longer living on South Pacific island

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means the following pieces come after

parts.note: the moa was a huge flightless New Zealand bird, now extinct

explanation.surface: An extinct bird once lived on an island in the South Seas.
explanation.definitionFit: The independent state in Polynesia is an island nation of the Pacific Ocean.

clue.text: Feverish complaint about right to disagree

indicators.note: about means going round, so the illness surrounds the letter

parts.note: ague is a fever with shivering, such as malaria

explanation.surface: A patient with a temperature claims the right to dispute something.
explanation.definitionFit: To quarrel or dispute is to disagree openly.

clue.text: Wagner's work, long involved with Rhine

indicators.note: involved means intricate and tangled, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A Wagner opera, lengthy and bound up with the Rhine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' scrambles LONG and RHINE together; Wagner's Ring operas also concern the Rhine, a neat false lead.
explanation.definitionFit: This romantic opera about a swan knight was composed by Richard Wagner.

clue.text: Material obtained from literary boatman on river

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above the next piece

parts.note: Harris is one of the three men in Jerome K Jerome's comic novel Three Men in a Boat
the Tweed is a river on the English-Scottish border

explanation.surface: Fabric is acquired from a fictional oarsman on a river.
explanation.definitionFit: This hand-woven woollen cloth from the Outer Hebrides is a well-known fabric.

clue.text: Coach with sense giving guidance to players

parts.note: a stage is a stagecoach, a horse-drawn coach
a sense can be a direction, as in the sense of a vector or rotation

explanation.surface: A sports coach with good sense advises the team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'players' wants to be sportsmen with a trainer, but they are actors.
explanation.definitionFit: Instructions in a script tell actors where to move and how to act.

clue.text: Spanish area in Sicilian port, look!

indicators.note: in says the word for look goes inside the port's name

parts.note: Catania is a port city on the east coast of Sicily
lo is an old exclamation meaning look

explanation.surface: Someone points out a region of Spain while in a Sicilian harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: The north-eastern region around Barcelona is an autonomous community of Spain.

clue.text: Gibes about trouble in island

indicators.note: about means round, so the word for gibes surrounds the trouble

parts.note: barbs are cutting remarks, gibes
ado is fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: Taunts concerning some difficulty on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: This easternmost Caribbean nation is an island in the West Indies.

clue.text: Turned Christian on, yet no longer news

indicators.note: turned means changed around, so all these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone converted to the faith, yet nobody cares any more.
explanation.definitionFit: Events from long ago, or anything stale and of no current interest, are said to be old news.

clue.text: Unnerve with mistake or bloomer

parts.note: to cow is to intimidate or unnerve
a slip is a small mistake

explanation.surface: Someone is thrown off balance by an error or a gaffe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' looks like another word for mistake, but here it is a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A yellow wild flower of meadows, it is a plant that blooms.

clue.text: Changed story about ruined tower

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: a ruined building is wrecked, so the letters of tower fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A tale was revised concerning a tower in ruins.
explanation.definitionFit: Revising a tale by writing it again means it has been changed.

clue.text: Supporting healthy yield

parts.note: pro means in favour of, supporting
fit means healthy

explanation.surface: Backing a robust harvest.
explanation.definitionFit: The return on an investment is its gain or yield.

clue.text: Oddjob's weapon, devastatingly throwable

indicators.note: devastation wrecks things, so the letters of throwable are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Bond villain's missile can be hurled to destructive effect.
explanation.walkthrough: Oddjob is the henchman in the Bond film Goldfinger who kills with a steel-rimmed hat.
explanation.definitionFit: Oddjob hurls his hard round-crowned hat as a deadly missile.

clue.text: Pick flower

definitions.meaning: the pick of something is its best part
the flower of a group is its finest members

explanation.definitionFit: Both mean the select best of a group.

clue.text: Look angry, depressed

explanation.definitionFit: One sense rhymes with 'flower' and means scowl; the other means brought down.

clue.text: Capital Henry invested in foodstore

indicators.note: invested in means placed inside, so the letter goes into the shop

parts.note: a deli is a delicatessen
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: A man named Henry has put money into a grocer's.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Henry' seems a person, but it is the physics unit.
explanation.definitionFit: The city is India's capital territory, home to New Delhi.

clue.text: Beginning as a driver

definitions.meaning: what a golfer does with a driver, hitting the ball from the tee

explanation.definitionFit: Golfers start each hole by striking from the tee, so the phrase also means starting anything.

clue.text: Network centre for company?

indicators.note: centre picks out the middle letters of the word Network

explanation.surface: The hub of a network serves a firm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'company' looks like a business, but the saying 'two's company' gives the number.
explanation.definitionFit: In the proverb 'two's company, three's a crowd', a pair is company.

clue.text: Top person seizing power in certain instant

indicators.note: seizing means holding inside, so the word for certain grips the letter

parts.note: sure means certain
a mo is a moment, an instant

explanation.surface: The leader grabs control in a split second.
explanation.definitionFit: The boss, the person in overall charge, is the top person.

clue.text: Brewer, for one, briefly retains beer, in a manner of speaking

indicators.note: retains means holds inside, so the short reference work contains the beer

parts.note: Brewer's is a famous dictionary of phrase and fable; dict is the short form of dictionary
ale is beer

explanation.surface: A brewer keeps beer, so to speak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brewer' suggests beer-making; it is E Cobham Brewer, compiler of the dictionary.
explanation.definitionFit: A regional form of a language is a particular way of talking.
